note: Feedback for the Checks of Unit 7. The design is docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-26-chemstudy-us-english-and-unit-1-check-feedback-design.md. Options are listed in the order they are to have on the page; the option with no message is the answer.

options.text: All of the NOCl has broken down.
options.message: Follow the moles of gas. Every 2 NOCl become 3 molecules of gas, so what pressure would complete breakdown give?

options.text: The mixture is at equilibrium, and it still holds NOCl, NO and Cl₂.

options.text: The gauge must have stuck, because the pressure of a reacting mixture always keeps changing.
options.message: A reacting mixture does not have to keep changing. What does a steady pressure say about net change?

options.text: Dissolving and crystallizing both stopped once their rates became equal.

options.text: The solution was not really saturated, so the crystal went on dissolving.

options.text: Ions were joining the crystal faster than they were leaving it.
